message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or agree on another target). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards and opponents still have cards left. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile; if it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction change card is played). On a turn, a player may play one card from their hand or draw from the draw pile. | | **Playing a Card** | • A card matches the top card of the discard pile by **color**, **number**, or **symbol**.
• Wild cards (Wild, Wild Draw Four) match any color; after playing them, the player chooses the next color. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (acts like Skip in two‑player games).
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and misses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player declares the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Same as +2 but also lets the player choose the next color. Must be used only if no matching color card exists in hand (otherwise the player can be challenged). | | **Drawing** | If a player cannot play a card, they must draw one card from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, they may play it immediately; otherwise, the turn ends. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When a player has only one card left, they must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to call UNO when required allows the next player to enforce a penalty: the offending player draws two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards: face value
• Draw Two / Reverse / Skip: 20 points each
• Wild / Wild Draw Four: 50 points each | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the agreed point threshold (commonly 500). | | **Variations & House Rules** | Many groups add house rules such as “Stacking” (players stack +2/+4 cards), “Seven-O” (play 7 to swap hands, 0 to reverse), or “Jump-In” (play out‑of‑turn if you have an exact match). Always clarify which variations will be used before starting. | --- ### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet | Action | What Happens | |--------|--------------| | Play a matching card | Discard it, follow any special effect | | Play a Wild | Declare new color | | Play a Wild Draw Four | Declare new color, next player draws four unless challenged | | Cannot play | Draw one card; if playable, may play it | | One card left | Say “UNO!” before next player starts | | Lose “UNO” | Next player draws two cards | | Finish a round | Winner gets points equal to sum of opponents’ cards | Feel free to ask if you'd like deeper details on specific cards, scoring examples, or how to handle challenges with Wild Draw Four!
